notes.title: CasterLords Demo is now playable!
notes.notes:
CasterLords is a single-player deck-building adventure game about powerful warlocks caught in an eternal cycle of death and rebirth.

Designed by H. Hochkins (Buck: Legacy, BAKA!, LuGame) the demo includes 3 playable characters, 250 cards, and 10 bosses - just a small taste of what's to come!

Got any comments or feedback? We'd love to hear it on the Steam forums!
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/812780/discussions/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/812780/discussions/[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35237376/eb8bb72fd1ac9a18718b3347a6017a9e5938fa11.png[/img]

As a quick note, this game is a work-in-progress. Much of the UI design is a draft, and the game doesn't feature many 'quality of life' features, such as Tooltips, Interactive Tutorial, History etc.

We have plans to complete the UI and implement all these quality of features and more when we are funded on Kickstarter. Please follow, and wishlist us if you want to be kept up-to-date.

Thank you and we hope you have fun!

Kind regards,
H. Hochkins
